query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as count, SUBSTRING(notes, 1, 100) as sample_note
FROM molecules 
WHERE notes LIKE '%[PUBCHEM:%'
GROUP BY SUBSTRING(notes, -80)
LIMIT 5;
